## Per-Agent Assignment

| Agent | Tier | Primary model | Fallback model | Rationale |
|-------|------|---------------|----------------|-----------|
| project-architect | S | gpt-6-astra | claude-opus-5.5 | Cross-feature architecture/security guardrails; highest reasoning score (90) for catching contract and NFR conflicts across all three features. |
| policy-parsing-engineer | S | claude-opus-5.5 | gpt-6-astra | XML/graph parsing with branch and loop-back modeling plus a hard security constraint (never evaluate policy expressions) — highest coding (87) and agentic (88.8) scores. |
| apim-connectivity-engineer | S | claude-opus-5.5 | gpt-6-sol | Credential/token handling (`DefaultAzureCredential`, `VIS-SEC-01`) is determinism/safety-critical; strong coding score with a cheaper high-scoring fallback. |
| qa-test-engineer | S | gpt-6-astra | claude-opus-5.5 | Reads all PRD/feature docs plus every task's validation output (context=3) to audit real vs. fabricated test coverage — needs the strongest reasoning to catch placeholder passes. |
| frontend-visualization-engineer | M | gpt-5.6-sol | gemini-3.8-flash | Scaffolds a full React/Vite app and diagram renderer (high code-gen volume) but lower architectural risk than the S-tier agents; balanced model is sufficient. |
| workflow-orchestrator | M | gpt-5.6-sol | gpt-5.6-terra | Invokes the `forge-workflow-engine` CLI and interprets JSON state/escalations rather than authoring feature code — balanced tier, no fabrication risk beyond faithful state reporting. |

`project-orchestrator` and `forge-team-builder` are forge meta-agents (tooling, not domain agents) and are intentionally left unscored/unassigned per skill guidance.
